reviews.title: AI Anesthesia Planning Assistant
reviews.body:
# AI Anesthesia Planning Assistant

Supports anesthesiologists.

Analyzes

• Allergies
• Previous Anesthesia
• Airway Risk
• Drug Interactions

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Airway, allergy, previous anesthesia and interaction analysis are decision-support inputs with source timing and uncertainty; AI cannot select anesthesia, declare airway safety or replace an anesthesiologist.

reviews.title: Pediatric Anesthesia Module
reviews.body:
Supports pediatric anesthesia.

Supports

• Risk Assessment

• Airway Management

• Recovery Monitoring

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Pediatric anesthesia risk, airway and recovery require age/weight context, qualified staffing and approved local protocols; this source supplies no dose, monitoring interval or discharge threshold.

reviews.title: Pediatric Perioperative Module
reviews.body:
Supports perioperative management.

Supports

• Preoperative Assessment
• Risk Stratification
• Intraoperative Monitoring
• Postoperative Recovery
• Enhanced Recovery Protocols

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Pre/intra/postoperative and enhanced-recovery profiles preserve protocol/version and responsible clinician; enhanced recovery does not override patient-specific restrictions or independently authorize discharge.

reviews.title: Pediatric Surgical Anesthesia Integration Module
reviews.body:
Integrates pediatric anesthesia workflows.

Supports

• Pre-anesthesia Assessment
• Medication Planning
• Intraoperative Monitoring
• Recovery Tracking

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Medication planning and intraoperative monitoring are source-owned clinical/device facts; anesthesia risk prediction requires its own intended-use evidence and cannot control delivery devices.
